```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\Url;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanSeeBeforeRulesPolicy;

class Url extends CanSeeBeforeRulesPolicy
{
    use HandlesAuthorization;

    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to see any URL
    }

    public function view(User $user, Url $url)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to view any URL
    }

    public function create(User $user)
    {
        return $user->hasRole('admin') || $user->can('create urls'); // Admins or users with the create role can create URLs
    }

    public function update(User $user, Url $url)
    {
        return $user->hasRole('admin') || $user->can('update urls'); // Admins or users with the update role can update URLs
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Url $url)
    {
        return $user->hasRole('admin') || $user->can('delete urls'); // Admins or users with the delete role can delete URLs
    }
}
```
